title: Epistemic Substitution: How Grokipedia's AI-Generated Encyclopedia Restructures Authority
abstract: arXiv:2512.03337v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: For more than two decades, Wikipedia has represented a decentralized, human-curated model of encyclopedic knowledge production. The emergence of AI-generated encyclopedias, such as Grokipedia, raises a fundamental question: do human- and AI-curated knowledge systems rely on the same foundations of epistemic authority? We examine this question through a comparative analysis of 1,000 matched Wikipedia--Grokipedia article pairs, comprising nearly 600,000 citation instances. Using an eight-category classification scheme, we construct the epistemic profiles of articles to examine the institutional composition of their cited sources. Our findings reveal substantial differences in sourcing practices. Grokipedia relies proportionally less on academic and journalistic sources and more on user-generated content and NGO and think-tank publications. translated_title: 认知替代：Grokipedia的AI生成百科全书如何重构权威结构
translated_abstract: 二十多年来，维基百科一直代表着一种去中心化、由人工策展的百科全书式知识生产模式。以Grokipedia为代表的AI生成百科全书的出现，提出了一个根本性问题：人工策展与AI策展的知识体系是否依赖于相同的认知权威基础？我们通过对1,000对匹配的维基百科——Grokipedia文章（包含近60万条引用实例）的比较分析来探讨这一问题。借助一套八类别的分类方案，我们构建了文章的认知特征，以考察其引用来源的机构构成。研究结果表明，两者在引用实践上存在实质性差异：Grokipedia对学术和新闻来源的依赖比例较低，而对用户生成内容以及非政府组织和智库出版物的依赖比例较高。这些差异在广泛的主题领域中长期存在，尽管其程度因具体主题而有所不同。
tldr: 该研究通过对比分析1,000对维基百科与Grokipedia文章的近60万条引用，揭示了AI生成的百科全书显著减少了对学术和新闻来源的依赖，转而更多引用用户生成内容及智库出版物，表明AI正在从基础上重构百科全书知识生产的认知权威结构。
en_tdlr: Through a comparative analysis of 1,000 matched Wikipedia–Grokipedia article pairs comprising nearly 600,000 citations, this study reveals that AI-generated encyclopedias systematically rely less on academic and journalistic sources and more on user-generated content and think-tank publications, fundamentally restructuring the foundations of epistemic authority in encyclopedic knowledge production.
